page.overview:
Who is Billy Hill?

Billy Hill is a supporting character in , played by Jeffrey Landman. He is the only friend of Jamie Lloyd.

Billy Hill is the classmate and friend of Jamie Lloyd, whom he also has a crush on. It is unknown if Billy went to the Haddonfield Children's Clinic like Jamie did. The only disability he was shown to have was a strong stutter.

On the morning on October 31, 1989, Billy witnesses Jamie having a vision of Michael at the Carruthers home. After Jamie learns her foster sister Rachel is all right, Jamie still feels like something is wrong and is visibly upset. Billy tries to comfort her, but she pushes him away.

Later that night, Billy dresses up as a pirate for Halloween and gives Jamie some flowers and his bracelet, which he tells her is for good luck. Jamie is touched by Billy's kindness and gives him a kiss as they get ready for the costume pageant. As soon as their names are called, Jamie has a vision of Tina Williams in danger and collapses. Jamie tries to explain where Tina is at but cannot speak all that well so Billy has to relay the information for her.
